title: Junta depending on few coordinates
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$, a function $f$ from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to a type $\beta$ is a $k$-junta if it depends only on some set of at most $k$ coordinates; that is, there is a subset $S$ of the coordinates with $|S|\le k$ such that $f$ depends only on coordinates in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the Boolean cube to a type $\beta$
